sources.source: Nepal TRĀYA Tsho Rolpa 2D Pre-Simulation Pilot Benchmark

sources.source: Nepal TRĀYA 2.0 2D Inertial Shallow-Water Solver (Bates et al., 2010) on ESA Copernicus DEM GLO-30

sources.source: Nepal TRĀYA Community Reporting Moderation Sandbox (Pre-MOU UAT)

sources.source: Nepal TRĀYA OASIS CAP v1.2 Multilingual Exercise Generator (Pre-MOU Sandbox)
sources.license_ref: MIT (TRĀYA CAP generator & schemas); upstream BIPAD NDRRMA statutory context, GloFAS CC-BY-4.0, USGS Public Domain, ODbL 1.0
